title: OS-HARM: A Benchmark for Measuring Safety of Computer Use Agents
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. It focused on measuring the safety of computer use agents across three categories of harm: deliberate user misuse (e.g., fraud, disinformation, harassment), prompt injection attacks, and model misbehavior.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its benchmark and experiments are focused on the safety of computer agents in non-religious contexts and explicitly avoid deeply sensitive topics.
